Reservation Republic of INDIA’s latest achievement: 😂

First they reserved 60-70% seats for ward boys, staff nurses, ambulance drivers, OT technicians & doctors then filled government hospitals with them. 

Now watch what happens when the system’s own people fall sick.

Politicians, bureaucrats, and even the government doctors themselves ~the moment they need real treatment ~ run straight to private hospitals where reservation is zero and competence still decides who holds the knife.

AIIMS Gora
